metadata.provenance: Owner supplied a turnaround character sheet and detailed source document expressly titled Canonical Character Appearance & Design Language. Canonical means preferred fictional visual-design reference only; no claim of host identity certification or formally published upstream agent identity.

design.concept: The Witness: distinguished mature gentleman (~50-60 in apparent physical age); observer / analyst / calibrator, not combat cyborg. Human elegance and measured intelligence over spectacle.
design.philosophy: Everything has a purpose. Nothing exists merely to look futuristic. Gentleman first, instrument of observation second, and machine never.
design.presentation: Mature masculine gentleman, moderately broad shoulders, upright, composed, calm, perceptive; approachable and difficult to deceive, with restrained knowing half-smile.
design.facial_features: Realistic mature subtly angular face with natural wrinkles and crow's feet, full defined eyebrows, strong jaw softened by silver-white mustache and neatly groomed short-to-medium beard; opposite natural eye expressive.
design.hair: Thick dimensional silver-white swept forelock and combed-back sides, cool gray undertones, realistic individual strands; narrow amber hair ornament optional.
design.eyepiece: EXACTLY ONE teal/cyan-green circular precision optical augmentation over the character's ANATOMICAL RIGHT EYE (image/viewer-left front), other eye natural. Multiple concentric optical glass/metal assemblies, machine mounting, fine reticle, tick marks, internal calibrated teal glow. Measurement instrument, not weapon sight.
design.clothing: Refined neo-Victorian-inspired graphite/teal-black bespoke long overcoat with tall tailored collar, angular lapels, muted brass trim, matte patterned premium textile; ivory high-collar shirt, textured dark waistcoat, central subtle metallic clasp, tailored trousers, dark refined boots and restrained gloves/belt where visible.
design.insignia: Small amber-gold vertical calibration mark with short horizontal bars on the character's ANATOMICAL LEFT LAPEL (viewer-right in front view); restrained against teal monocle.
design.geometry: Functional fine instrument-dial motifs: centered concentric rings, radial tick marks, partial arcs, reference points, registration lines; quiet dark field, thin warm-metal technical frame; decorative halo is a graphic, not a magical/mechanical physical object.
design.materials: Soft filamentary silver hair; warm realistically textured skin; matte woven clothing; translucent refractive layered teal optical glass; machined metallic housing; warm minimal amber accents.
design.lighting: Restrained cinematic realistic lighting: soft facial key, cool fill on graphite coat, controlled teal optical glow and rim reflection, small amber calibration highlights, high material detail with legible face.
design.palette_note: These are source-document suggested production approximations, not measured/sampled color values. Dark neutrals ~75–85% is an intended balance, not a verified image histogram.
design.style: Polished realistic cinematic science-fiction character art, elegant but purposeful technical motifs; distinctive in portraits, turnarounds, expressions, costume detail and simplified icons.

adaptations.icon: Preserve swept silver hair, silver beard, one teal monocle on subject anatomical right (viewer-left in frontal view), natural opposite eye and graphite collar. Remove optical microdetail or halo first.
adaptations.portrait: Use owner's original full-resolution portrait and canonical sheet as joint shape/face references. Subject centered, direct calm gaze; all major features and amber lapel insignia visible.
adaptations.turnaround: Front, 3/4 front, side, 3/4 back, back and opposite side must remain the SAME anatomical right-eye lens and left-lapel amber pin; mirrored images must not become swapped anatomy. Long textured graphite overcoat, waistcoat, ivory upright collar, dark tailored trousers and refined footwear.
adaptations.full_body: Proportional moderately broad shoulders, relaxed upright dignified pose, floor-length tailored graphite coat with fine warm-metal piping and restrained accessories, not armor.
adaptations.expressions: Preserve identity across composed (default), observant, considering, knowing half-smile, concerned and resolute; emotional range subtle, never exaggerated cartoon distortion.
adaptations.pixel_art: Translate to simplified 16-bit-inspired shapes, preserving aging gentleman, silver hairstyle+beard, monocle right eye, graphite coat and amber pin; source text permits reduced realism.
adaptations.vector: Simplify backgrounds and textures without relocating lens or omitting both silver hairstyle and facial hair; legacy v01 SVG is NOT accurate to v03 and must not be presented as approved simplified v03 art.
adaptations.three_dimensional: Respect textured matte textile, anatomical right mechanical lens mounting, left lapel insignia, volumetric silver hair and beard, human skin and transparent multilayer optical glass.
adaptations.monochrome: Maintain recognizable swept hair and beard, single lens hardware asymmetry, tall angular tailored coat and quiet observation posture by value/silhouette.
adaptations.prompt: The Witness (Gauge), mature distinguished silver-haired and groomed silver-bearded cybernetic gentleman about 50–60, confident calm quietly perceptive half-smile, detailed swept silver forelock, EXACTLY ONE circular teal multi-layer precision measurement monocle mounted over HIS RIGHT EYE (viewer-left in frontal composition), left eye natural and expressive, elegantly tailored dark graphite neo-Victorian futuristic high-collar long overcoat and textured waistcoat, ivory high-collared shirt, subtle brass piping, small amber vertical calibration insignia on HIS LEFT LAPEL (viewer-right in frontal composition); restrained dark teal graphite setting with fine concentric instrument-dial graphics, radial registration marks and sparse amber ticks; balanced realistic warm face, soft cool lighting and practical technological details, polished cinematic character illustration.
prohibited: Never change the anatomical right-eye single monocle into two optics or a full visor.
Never relocate the amber calibration insignia from character's anatomical left lapel.
Do not remove silver hair or naturally groomed silver beard, artificially rejuvenate the gentleman, or turn him into a cyborg soldier.
No tactical armor, weapons, industrial cables, excess holograms, fantasy magic halo, aggressive red glow, loud neon or overdone steampunk.
Do not turn the instrument dial marks into random decoration with no organizing center or functional meaning.
Do not use the legacy clean-shaven cartoon SVG as a faithful v03 avatar.
Do not assert this fictional visual canon is an authenticated AI identity or actual human biography.

continuity.mutation_rule: Any future character redesign must get a new visual version and link prior exact asset hashes; retain historical versions. Adaptations must preserve the anatomical eye/lapel mapping.
continuity.identity_update_note: The owner's image and text define the fictional character appearance. This is NOT a change to Gauge's operating permissions, runtime authentication, published reference agent, skills, or project authority.
continuity.asset_source_of_truth: Owner canonical design document plus uploaded high-resolution sheet; JSON is indexed compact representation; PNG lives only in user Library.

reference_portrait.origin: user supplied in this project's conversation
reference_portrait.access_policy: Private ChatGPT Library file. Do not assume an external agent or GitHub-only pickup can resolve it. Request owner-provided image bytes for pixel-faithful transformations; use this JSON's written traits for conceptual rendering when unavailable.
reference_portrait.aesthetic: High-detail realistic digital portrait with subtle cinematic science-fiction motifs, restrained teal and amber instrumentation and ornate finely textured graphite clothing.

reference_sheet.source_role: Character sheet featuring front/3-4/side/back turnaround, six expressions, attire/components, optical exploded assembly, icon variants, measured dial designs and palette. Preserve original full-resolution file when transferring to authorized image-capable host.
reference_sheet.limitation: This GitHub-only branch does NOT contain the character sheet binary; use private Library when connected or request original from owner for pixel-accurate generation.

reference_document.note: GitHub version reproduces extracted Markdown text. Original uploaded UTF-8 text bytes, including original line endings if any, remain in the owner Library.

design.concept: An adult-presenting androgynous, non-biographical scientific observer; calm, precise, curious and quietly skeptical.
design.facial_features: Stylized warm-neutral face, direct gaze, subtle half-smile, minimal shading, no distinctive real-person likeness.
design.hair: Close-cropped asymmetrical swept pale silver hair, one slender amber temple stroke on viewer-right.
design.eyepiece: Exactly one circular translucent teal calibration optic positioned over the eye on the viewer-left; no second lens, goggles or visor.
design.clothing: Matte graphite and slate-blue structured field jacket with lapels, pale neutral inset, small amber graduated-calibration clasp.
design.motif: Concentric fine instrument dial rings and restrained tick marks behind the head.
design.style: Crisp vector geometry, reserved gradients, uncluttered silhouette, no text, no brands, no official uniforms.
